notes.title: RollerForce UPDATE v1.1
notes.content:
We listened to your feedback!  Here is a nice update to the shooting mechanics, as well as a new default weapon type (touch pad click down).
Please let us know what you think in the forums!
Have fun and thank you for your support!!!
- Drew

Build notes - RollerForce v1.1
- Addressed shooting issues & improved bullet behavior 
- New default "Pulse" weapon, Green missiles are now alternate bullets
- FX improvements and optimizations
- audio fixes
- Track modifications
- general optimizations
